hook: A shield blocked Java4Shell without a restart

beats.say: OpenAI and Cisco are launching Shirudo, an open-source runtime that protects running Linux systems while teams roll out patches.
It uses eBPF to block vulnerable code paths live. In a controlled test, a Codex-generated shield stopped a Java4Shell exploit against a running Elasticsearch service, with no restart.
Shields are cryptographically signed, checked by the eBPF verifier, and logged with a TPM. It's BSD licensed, and a technical webinar follows on December 15.
